pr_title: Increase default item listing size `ISSUE_PAGING_NUM` to 20
pr_body:
This increases the default value for listings of issues, projects and milestones to 20, for better UX and consistency with other listings.

For reference, GH uses 25 and 30 items in most listings, but they have a slightly more compact layout too.

closes #20184
pr_comments:
LGTM (ps: CI failure is related, it seems that some tests assume that the page size must be 10 😂)

issue_context.title: Issue List Page Size
issue_context.body:
### Feature Description

It would be nice if the list under Repo->Issues would either load dynamically more pages when scrolling down, or the default page size would be a bit higher or configurable. 

10 is quite annoying if you search for something, especially as search only matches full words.

### Screenshots

_No response_
comments:
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/main/custom/conf/app.example.ini

```
;; Number of issues that are displayed on one page
;ISSUE_PAGING_NUM = 10
```

while I think the default value should be larger. 10 is too small indeed.

review_comments:
Yeah, `RepoSearchPagingNum` is undocumented for years now 🙃 I don't want to add just another paging_num to the docs here. But changing the value too seemed reasonable to me, idk

(I'm not convinced at all if it makes sense to have all these separate settings for all various listings, especially given that ISSUE_PAGING_NUM ended up being used for other things than issues.. Maybe it's time to drop these settings, considering that breaking these settings will not be very.. breaking for users) → #20550
